referee_caveats_inferred: Inclination and Omega are set from gas kinematics assuming co-planarity with the orbit, so the orbit is partly circular reasoning with the ALMA data
The PMa is attributed entirely to C with a single 2016 epoch, and the likelihood is not given
The ALMA position comes from one epoch, so the orbit rests mostly on a single astrometric point plus indirect constraints
Flat priors on M_A and i make the quoted M_C depend on poorly constrained parameters
Best-fit values are the maximum likelihood with posterior standard deviations, which are asymmetric and not directly comparable to medians

missing_for_reproduction: ALMA imaging and calibration settings (deferred to ATOMIUM papers)
likelihood and exact constraint implementation of the UltraNest fit
PMa catalog values source and sensitivity-function procedure
stellar parameters and opacity assumptions used in the disk model
reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Roughly 50-200 GB raw for the three array configurations of the large program; the released image cubes and a continuum-only astrometry check need far less (inferred, not stated)
reproducibility.score_reason: ALMA data are public and the orbit priors and sampler settings are given with numeric results, but ALMA imaging details, the likelihood and the PMa inputs are not stated and no code is released.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Public data and numeric results exist, but the ALMA imaging recipe and the orbital likelihood are not given, so a faithful redo is not possible from the paper alone.

methods_papers.why: steady optically thick accretion-disk temperature profile

companion_papers.why: CO kinematics of the inner wind, v_LSR and an upper mass limit for C
possible weak shaping of the wind by the distant companion B

related_projects_or_surveys: VLT/SPHERE ToO program coordinated with the ATOMIUM ALMA long baseline campaign
